title: Juda Zainab Say Na Karo Logo
body:
Juda Zainab say na kero logo rida meri wirasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Sazayen jitni bhi day do mujhay manzoor hai lekin Haya meri virasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Larnay ko mera Ghazi aa jaye phir say ran main gira itna soch loo’n tou
Main fakhr e kun ki beti hoon mujhay bay Bas na samjho tum dua meri wirasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haider ki ladli hoon waris imamato ka mitnay kabhi na doo’n gi
Sitam main naqsh e Ahmad ko bachana meray dada ki Ada meri wirasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ek baat yad rakhna touqeer meray ghar ki Allah hi janta hai
Sitam jitnay bhi hon mujh pay magar har haal main shukar e Khuda meri wirasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tatheer ki amaa’n main esmat kay gulistaa’n main logo palli barhi hoon
Hassan Shabir kay hotay main Zainab hoon yehi sab say juda meri wirasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Yasrab main tha phiraya qaidi bana kay jisko touqeer hoon main uski
Qasam baba ki rasiyon ki samajhti hoon aseeri main saza meri wirasat hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Shabir aay Khuda nay lazim kaha yeh hoga Zainab say itna kehna
Lutaya ghar ko hai tu nay kay ab say jo bhi hai teri raza meri warasat hai..
